title: Judge Again Denies Trump’s Request to Move Hush-Money Case to Federal Court
summary: The ruling, from Judge Alvin K. Hellerstein, blocks President Trump’s quickest path to overturning his 2024 conviction for covering up hush-money payments to a porn star.
